paragraphs: Rabbi Binyamin bar Levi. Avin in his name, Jerusalem Horayot 1; Rav Huna in his name, Naso Rabbah 13; Esther Rabbah, end of section 2. Chazit, “Awake north,” has Yehoshua bar Binyamin bar Levi on that matter—necessarily erroneous. Tzav 9: Yose in Binyamin bar Levi’s name; there 186a, Yochanan in his name. He said that Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbi Immi were sitting, Jerusalem Pe'ah’s beginning. Zavdi, perhaps his brother.
